name: shodan_search
description: Search Shodan for internet-connected devices/services, or get detailed info about a specific host. Call with action='search' and a Shodan query for general searches, or action='host_info' with a specific IP address for detailed information about that one host.

action.description: search: query Shodan for matching devices/services. host_info: detailed info about one specific IP address.

query.description: Shodan search query (supports Shodan's search syntax, e.g. 'apache country:US'). Required for action='search'.

ip_address.description: A specific IP address to look up. Required for action='host_info'.

limit.description: Max results for action='search'. Defaults to 10.
